description: This PHP class 'TerminationReasonConfigurationDao' provides data access methods for managing termination reasons within the OrangeHRM system, including CRUD operations, listing, counting, and checking existence of termination reasons.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing termination reasons, including CRUD operations, listing, and validation within the HRM system.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Persists a TerminationReason entity to the database.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingTerminationReasonIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing termination reasons matching provided IDs.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Retrieves a termination reason by its name.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of termination reasons based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for listing termination reasons with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Counts the number of termination reasons matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes termination reasons by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason name already exists.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of termination reasons currently in use by employees.
